description: This file defines API routes for authentication and authorization using FastAPI, including user registration, login, role assignment, user profile retrieval, and toggling registration availability.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Request model for user registration containing username, password, and roles.

classes.name: RegisterResponse
classes.description: Response model for successful user registration containing user ID, username, roles, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for user login containing username and password.

classes.name: LoginResponse
classes.description: Response model for login containing access token, token type, and expiry.

classes.name: AssignRoleRequest
classes.description: Request model for assigning a role to a user.

classes.name: AssignRoleResponse
classes.description: Response model after assigning a role, including user ID, username, and roles.

classes.name: UserProfileResponse
classes.description: Response model for user profile details including user ID, username, roles, and active status.

classes.name: ToggleRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Request model for toggling registration enabled/disabled.

classes.name: ToggleRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating registration toggle status and message.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Handles user registration, with checks for registration enablement and bootstrap behavior.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login and token issuance.

methods.name: assign_role
methods.description: Assigns a role to an existing user, requires current user context.

methods.name: toggle_registration
methods.description: Enables or disables registration at runtime, restricted to admin users.
